headline: Anupam Rasayan India Limited: Allotment of Securities
sum: Allotment of Securities — Anupam Rasayan India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding issuance and allotment of up to 16,000 (sixteen thousand) INR denominated, secured, rated, unlisted and redeemable non-convertible debentures with…
detail: Allotment of Securities — Anupam Rasayan India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding issuance and allotment of up to 16,000 (sixteen thousand) INR denominated, secured, rated, unlisted and redeemable non-convertible debentures with nominal value of INR 1,00,000 (Indian Rupees One Lakh Only) each, aggregating to not more than INR 1,60,00,00,000 (Indian Rupees One Hundred Sixty Crore Only), in one single tranche.
